title: dryopteris affinis var. rubiginosa
intro: Dryopteris affinis var. rubiginosa, commonly known as the rusty-leaved buckler fern, is a variety of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The health benefits of Dryopteris affinis var. rubiginosa include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and promoting wound healing.
